dataset_name: Rubin Observatory Simonyi Survey Telescope — FEA perturbation files
description: 24 FITS archives providing FEA perturbation files for LSST/Rubin M1M3 and M2 optical assemblies under horizon/zenith gravity sag and thermal loads.
caveat: Meniscus mirror geometry actively supported; serves as real physics analog for gravity sag node displacements and Zernike fitting.
